correctness.rationale: The exact forward-orbit identity is proved using finite permutation inverses modulo all m coprime to six, yielding translation by 2. The 2m lift uses A and C with 3 a unit; the 3m lift uses C, A∘B and B with 2 a unit. Every modulus not divisible by six has precisely one of the two permitted prime-power lift decompositions. The maps never output 1 mod 6. Boundaries m=1 and all integer word lengths are addressed. Actual BFS for 2000 moduli corroborated the proof, but was not substituted for it.

value.rationale: The motivating 2025 work highlights the unsettled arithmetic of this exact orbit. The claim completely answers its natural finite-congruence reachability problem, drawing a sharp boundary between universal reachability at every prime power and obstruction at the mixed modulus six. The explicit invertible-base and noninvertible-lifting principles are potentially reusable beyond this example. It is not simply an arbitrary computed finite list; it is a quantified classification valid for all moduli, independent of the unresolved ordinary-density question.
